name: Employed by Guaq AI
description: Search live job postings read from about 5,000 employers' own applicant-tracking systems, research an employer's hiring, and brief a hiring market.
notes: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration is handled by the hosted Employed MCP server; no client credentials are needed. Search tools are read-only; account tools change only the signed-in user's own profile, application tracker and alerts, and never apply to jobs or contact employers.
installHint: Sign in with an Employed account when the authentication flow starts; a free account is enough to start.
